''' Ronald Micura''' is an Austrian chemist. He received his PhD working in the field of [[phycobilin]] pigments under the supervision of Karl Grubmayr in 1995. He was awarded the [[Lieben Prize]] in 2005.<ref>{{cite web|title=Kopf der Woche: Prof. Ronald Micura |url=https://www.uibk.ac.at/archive/ipoint/kopf_der_woche/293805.html |date=4 November 2005 |website= |language= |access-date=1 March 2026}}</ref>

Micura studied chemistry at the [[Johannes Kepler University Linz]],<ref>{{cite thesis|type=Diplom |date=1993 |last=Micura |first=Ronald |title=Ring-A Iminoester von 2,3-Dihydrobilindionen |language=de |location=Linz |publisher=Universität Linz}}</ref> where he also received his Ph.D. in 1995.<ref>{{cite thesis|type=PhD |date=1995 |last=Micura |first=Ronald |title=Seryl-Iminoester von 2,3-Dihydro-Bilindionen als Modelle für die Chromophor-Protein-Wechselwirkung im Phytochrom |language=de |location=Linz |publisher=Universität Linz}}</ref> After postdoc positions at the [[ETH Zurich]] 1996-1997 and the [[Scripps Research|Skaggs Institute for Chemical Biology]] 1997-1998, both with [[Albert Eschenmoser]] (holding such a position "in the 3rd generation", after his PhD supervisor Grubmayr 1982/83, and the latter's PhD supervisor [[Heinz Falk]] in 1971),<ref name=PhD_AE>{{cite web|title=Postdoktoranden |url=https://l-i-c.org/pub/1136/Albert-Eschenmoser-postdocs.pdf |website=Lives in Chemistry - Albert Eschenmoser |publisher=GNT Publishing GmbH |access-date=1 March 2026}}</ref> he returned to Linz leading a research group. Micura moved to the [[University of Innsbruck]] in 2002, where he submitted his [[Habilitation]],<ref>{{cite thesis|type=Habilitation |date=2002 |last=Micura |first=Ronald |title=Contributions to the influence of nucleoside modifications on RNA structure and function |language=en |location=Innsbruck |publisher=Universität Innsbruck}}</ref> became full professor (non-tenured) in 2004,<ref>{{cite web|title=Kopf der Woche: Ronald Micura |url=https://www.uibk.ac.at/archive/ipoint/kopf_der_woche/1149.html |date=19 July 2004 |website= |language=de |access-date=1 March 2026}}</ref> and was promoted to a tenured position in 2008.
